purpose: The dialog control (sap.m.Dialog) pauses the current app flow to collect a response or decision from the user. It requires explicit input — confirmation, cancellation, or data entry — before proceeding.
whenToUse: To display complex content (not a floorplan) without leaving the current page
To display an additional step or process that needs to be confirmed by a user action
To enable users to create an object with a small number of fields
whenNotToUse: Don't use to display a simple message — use MessageBox instead
Don't use to confirm a successful action
Don't use when you don't want to interrupt the user
Don't use for creating objects with a large number of fields — use Object Page instead
Don't use to display a floorplan — floorplans are not meant to be inside a dialog
doRules: Always use an Emphasized button for the single primary action in the footer
Use Transparent button for Cancel or any negative-path single action
Use the stretch property (full-screen mode) on smartphones (size S)
Use message popover for surfacing validation errors in scrollable forms
Keep editing dialogs simple — use an Object Page if many fields are needed
Enable resizable (resizable=true) and draggable (draggable=true) properties for tool-like dialogs on desktop
dontRules: Never use an Emphasized button for Cancel
Don't put a floorplan inside a dialog
Don't use a message popover in small dialogs where it obscures form fields
Don't use Dialog for a simple message — use MessageBox
Don't use Dialog for long forms — use navigation to a details page instead

layoutGuidance.placement: Centered on screen in a modal window. Full-screen on S (smartphone) with stretch property.
layoutGuidance.sizing: Auto width and height. Height stops 4rem from top/bottom when content exceeds screen height — content area scrollable. Desktop: Compact mode. Tablet: Cozy mode.
layoutGuidance.spacing: Internal padding follows Compact/Cozy density. Footer action buttons right-aligned. LTR: buttons on right. RTL: buttons on left.
layoutGuidance.alignment: Header top (gray background). Content middle. Optional subheader below header (not scrollable). Footer with actions at bottom.

contentGuidance.labelLength: Title 1–8 words summarizing dialog purpose. Body explains what user must decide.
contentRules: Action button labels are verbs in imperative
Only one primary (Emphasized) action per dialog
Data is lost if user clicks Cancel or refreshes page — warn users accordingly

responsiveBehavior.XL: Centered, Compact mode, auto width. Resize handle available.
responsiveBehavior.L: Centered, Compact mode, auto width. Content scrollable at max height.
responsiveBehavior.M: Cozy mode. Pop-in behavior for responsive tables inside dialog.
responsiveBehavior.S: Recommend full-screen mode (stretch=true). Toolbar/actions at bottom.

accessibilityGuidance.requirement: Escape closes dialog. Tab cycles within dialog (focus trap). Focus returns to trigger element on close.
Focus moves into dialog on open. Returns to trigger on close.
Dialog has accessible title via aria-labelledby
Dialog open/close announced to screen readers. Content announced when opened.

incompatible: Inside another Dialog — don't stack dialogs
Floorplans (List Report, Object Page) — not meant to be inside a dialog

exceptions: MessageBox is a specialized dialog subtype for quick messages — use MessageToast for success messages instead
Resizable dialog: shows resize handle in bottom-right corner on desktop only
Draggable dialog: click-and-drag header to reposition (draggable=true)
